reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so we cancelled. Paying ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month, even in slow months, for something my stylists may again refuse to use is not a risk I want; I count my drawer myself and the register works.
objection: My staff won't do a selfie check-in and type every bill into a phone app. In two months it will sit unused like last time and I will still be paying.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and pay only after my stylists have actually used it every day for a full month, so I see it working in my own salon before any money goes out.
